description: Turn a natural-language show description into a validated cue list (SetlistSchema, scenes[] variant). Uses the local LLM when configured, falls back to a deterministic grammar parser otherwise. Optionally chains into create_cue_sequencer.

apply.description: If true, also build a cue_sequencer rig from the produced setlist.

bars.description: Hint at total length in bars; LLM/grammar fits cues within.

bpm.description: Show tempo. Defaults to 120 if neither bpm nor a parsed cue overrides.

containerName.description: When apply=true, passed through to create_cue_sequencer as `name`.

preferLlm.description: If false, skip the LLM and use the grammar parser directly.

style.description: Stylistic prior — biases default cue names + morph times.

title.description: Optional show/setlist title for the output `title` field.

name: compose_cue_list
title: Compose cue list (NL → setlist)
